{{Top|leg}}
The '''900s BBY''' was the first century of the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. During that period of [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lune Banjeer]] and his successors led the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] in the [[Unification Campaigns]], a series of military conflicts in the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
